packages.name: ABS Ultra Gamer
features: Direct BGP Peering to Steam & Discord

services.title: Ultra-Fast Fiber Broadband
services.shortDescription: Direct GPON fiber-to-the-home connectivity with zero packet drop and true symmetrical speeds.
services.fullDescription: ABS Network delivers genuine optical fiber to your doorstep. Backed by multi-homed upstream carrier links, our FTTH network delivers uninterrupted 4K streaming, instant downloads, and crystal-clear video conferences with zero bandwidth throttling.
features: No Data Capping or Fair Usage Policies

services.title: Leased Lines & DIA
services.shortDescription: 1:1 unshared internet access with guaranteed bandwidth, custom BGP peering, and 99.99% uptime SLA.
services.fullDescription: Engineered for financial institutions, software houses, call centers, and multi-branch enterprises that cannot compromise on uptime. Our leased line service features redundant backhauls, low latency routes, and round-the-clock NOC monitoring.

services.title: Managed IT & Network Solutions
services.shortDescription: Complete office Wi-Fi meshing, structured cabling, VPN interconnects, and enterprise firewall deployment.
services.fullDescription: From greenfield office cabling to multi-site SD-WAN interconnections, ABS Network handles your complete physical and logical network infrastructure. We deploy enterprise-grade access points, switches, and UTM firewalls.

services.title: Fiber & Networking Equipment Sales
services.shortDescription: Professional-grade fiber optic cables, switches, routers, ONTs, and structured cabling equipment for ISPs and enterprises.
services.fullDescription: ABS Network supplies enterprise-grade networking and fiber optic equipment from trusted global brands. Whether you need fiber patch panels, managed switches, enterprise access points, or structured cabling kits, we provide competitive pricing with manufacturer-backed warranties.
features: Fiber Optic Patch Panels & Splice Closures

services.title: Web & Digital Services
services.shortDescription: High-performance web development, custom cloud hosting, API integrations, and SEO engineering.
services.fullDescription: Accelerate your digital transformation with our bespoke web and software engineering team. We craft high-speed Next.js web applications, secure cloud infrastructure, responsive enterprise portals, and search optimization.
features: Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals Optimization

services.title: 24/7 Tier-3 NOC & Field Support
services.shortDescription: Round-the-clock network operations center with rapid-response fiber splicing and field repair teams.
services.fullDescription: Our Network Operations Center (NOC) operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. With automated optical power anomaly detection and on-ground field technicians equipped with OTDR testers, we resolve physical anomalies in record time.

contactSubmissions.subject: Inquiry for 75 Mbps Fiber Connection in Sector F-10

contactSubmissions.internalNotes: Contacted client regarding site survey schedule. Proposal to be emailed today.
